claim_verdicts.why: The triage note N006 says NKDA, but the 2024 clinic note C005 records a serious documented amoxicillin reaction in 2019, and C006 says penicillins are still avoided. claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The triage entry may reflect incomplete intake; the allergy list A007 says no other allergies are recorded, which is itself at odds with C005.
